fixed_recipes.aggregation: Per neuron, mean within source sample, equal mean across22 samples
fixed_recipes.attachment: For every candidate donor, unchanged mouselight_external_test.attach: compact_attachment500um, then1000um, otherwise translation of that same complete TRAIN arbor
fixed_recipes.baseline: Reproduce sealed E1 donor attachment and compare BOTH scores to the saved per-query primary metrics within absolute tolerance1e-9
fixed_recipes.distance_oracle: Choose donor with minimum distance_um; tie exactly by ascending donor ID. Report BOTH its distance and F1.
fixed_recipes.f1_oracle: Choose donor with maximum f1_200; tie exactly by ascending donor ID. Report BOTH its distance and F1.
fixed_recipes.joint_improvement: Count queries for which at least one single donor has distance strictly lower AND F1 strictly higher than E1. Report raw count/fraction, per-animal counts/fractions and equal-animal mean fraction.
fixed_recipes.pareto: Report standard weak dominance (distance<=E1 and F1>=E1, with at least one strict), plus the complement of strict BOTH-improvement separately; do not conflate them.
fixed_recipes.truth: Previously fixed source conversion/admission and canonical50um arbors; retain every measured cable/connector; no clipping

interpretation_limits: Truth-assisted choices are not predictors, validation or confirmatory results.
An oracle requires revealed query geometry and cannot choose a hidden donor in any future prediction.
Headroom establishes candidate geometry availability only; it does not establish learnability from soma, labels, images or genes.
Only the already fixed sixteen-neighbour pool is examined. Absence of headroom here is not a whole-TRAIN-library or biology ceiling.
Report the two individually attainable oracle metric pairs; never combine their separately optimized metrics into a fictitious joint prediction.
No new fit, download, frozen-experiment rerun/change, source profile inference, website change or invented geometry.
question: Within the SAME sixteen sealed TRAIN donors for each revealed external query, how much attainable donor-selection headroom exists over E1?

scope.admission: Reuse the fixed primary ADMISSION exactly; no new exclusions
scope.donor_pool: The sixteen donor_ids in the sealed E1_local_uniform prediction row for each query; no global library expansion or ceiling claim
scope.truth_status: All external outcomes are already REVEALED. This diagnostic explicitly uses their answers and is development only.
